verdict.rationale: The only path in the evidence to operating AWS with natural language is indirect: official open-source MCP servers for AWS (awslabs/mcp), which let an external AI agent drive AWS. These are documented only by a title-level mention. The AWS CLI's auto-prompt and completion are structured command aids, not natural-language input, and Bedrock/AgentCore are for building your own agents rather than operating AWS conversationally. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface or assistant in the console or CLI, documentation of what the MCP servers can operate, and hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
